author: Elena
citation: So, we crashed for that night at an amazing beach with no one else around. ... The next morning we woke up with the first glimpse of sun, under a bunch of coconut palms, whispering the song of the wind. The night was magnificent.
location: Deserted islet beach, Togian Islands, Sulawesi, Indonesia
provenance: Personal travel account by Elena (ElenasTravelgram) published on Bunch of Backpackers, describing spending the night directly on the white sand of a remote beach after arranging with a local.

author: Verónica Santos
citation: No dia 01 de Maio de 2014, eu e o meu marido passamos a noite em Maya Bay... é hora de dormir a olhar para o céu.
location: Maya Bay, Phi Phi Islands, Thailand
provenance: First-person account by reader Verónica Santos published on 360meridianos blog, detailing an overnight tour where they spent the night on Maya Bay beach under the stars (with additional comments confirming sleeping on the sand).
